requirement: Return one metric rule as a read-only projection: its parent metric name, its criterion with rendered formula, and either the rendered score function plus its formula DTO or the major/minor weight; a missing id is reported as ResourceNotFound.

preconditions.text: The requested metric rule exists and is live
The rule is a scoring rule or a major/minor rule
The parent metric and the criterion exist
The requested id matches no live rule

inputs.text: Query for four scoring rules with constant, variable, arithmetic, and ternary score functions
Query for a rule whose id is not stored
Query for the CURB-65 scoring rule of the age criterion
Query for a rule that was soft deleted beforehand
Query for a major rule of the IDSA/ATS metric
Query for a minor rule of the IDSA/ATS metric

returns.text: Success with the rule id, parent metric id and name, and criterion
A scoring rule renders its score function text and formula DTO with no major/minor flag
A major/minor rule renders its weight and no score function
Failure with ResourceNotFound and a null payload

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing or soft-deleted rule is returned as a failed Result
